archetypes.name: dyn-oos-rollup
archetypes.rationale: Design OOS rollup annotation now maps one issue URL to multiple originals.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the design OOS annotate path for cap-1 rollup correctness. Check that only unambiguous single-slot issue output maps to every original OOS id, failed slots remain excluded, and reruns recover from OOS_FILE_MAP rows without refiling. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
